_doc: LEGACY RESIDUAL V1 ONLY; provisional historical estimates retained for compatibility. Direct v2 uses models/policy_v2_budget.json and generated nn_policy_budget.h. PROVISIONAL (not engine-measured yet). log_* = in-turn enqueue (memcpy) cost only; base64+fwrite (~8-12 fuel/byte) runs in nnh::idle() from leftover fuel. turn_allowance raised 30000->55000 by lead so a K=16 decision plus the shared encoder is admissible; must be re-derived from engine measurements.
